info.title: npchelper 2.3.0 - tools for NPC Helper 2 content packs, translations and DLL mods
info.description: Command-line tool for NPC Helper 2: create, validate, inspect and package Stardew Valley NPC content packs and DLL mods.

commands.name: inspect
commands.description: Show what the game will see.

commands.name: dll-mod
commands.description: Create a C# SMAPI mod project.

commands.name: npc
commands.description: Add an NPC to a pack.

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Create a content pack with a starter NPC.

commands.name: pack
commands.description: Validate, then zip for upload (--force to pack despite name mistakes).

commands.name: release
commands.description: Build several archives and NuGet packages from one manifest.

options.name: --locale
options.description: Load the NPC with that language applied.

options.name: --base
options.description:
For a translation-only pack: the pack that adds the NPC. Reports keys that do not exist there
and how much is still untranslated.

options.name: --strict
options.description: Treat warnings as failures (useful in a build script).
